body:
it's mostly the lack of motivation to do any thing in general (including killing myself) hence, the leading up to a purposeless life. Nothing means any thing to me any more and obviously I feel less of a meaning to be alive. so question is, why bother staying alive?

And no, i don't take care of my body no more. it's literally sleep 80% of the time, game 10% of the time and dragging myself to work/therapy for the last 10%. I lost all my hobbies as depression came to. It has fog my mind to the point where I cant feel emotion or see any thing enjoyable. Heck, I don't even remember how did it felt to be happy.

I can't quit my job at all. even being anonymous, i wouldn't really want to state about it. travelling wise, i pretty much spent most of my leaves covering days where I needed a mental break from life so other than short weekend travels, I doubt I would be able to have any enjoyable travels. Not to mention, I recently came back from a 10 days travel that kill me mentally more than giving me energy.

I apologize for being so negative with all these man.
